research_mode: official ONS, OSR and Police.uk sources only; current crime-statistics production and designation, 2025-2027 crime-data-integrity inspection design, IT and QA oversight, NDQIS and PND quality controls, and stop-search precision and missing-state contracts; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: ONS assurance boundary
verified_claims: ONS is two steps removed from police-force record-level data
ONS relies on Home Office collation and QA
without record-level access ONS checks are largely consistency based
limitations: published aggregate consistency is not record-level accuracy
quality claims must reflect dependency

sources.name: Reaccreditation decision gate
verified_claims: the quality review is a step toward possible reaccreditation
critical recommendations must be addressed first
OSR will decide reassessment readiness after sufficient improvement
limitations: reaccreditation is not automatic
current official-statistics status must be preserved

sources.name: National Data Quality Improvement Service scope
verified_claims: NDQIS targets flagged collections
examples include knife crime domestic abuse and online crime
computer-assisted classification has been used to improve consistency
limitations: tools apply to defined collections
tool output is not direct parcel evidence

sources.name: NDQIS transparency requirement
verified_claims: ONS should publish and update NDQIS developments
methods should be documented
strengths and limitations of tools should be communicated
limitations: programme existence does not prove all actions complete
tool versions require dates

sources.name: National policing data-quality proposals
verified_claims: the Data Foundations stream proposed a national data quality framework
it proposed a national data quality register
it proposed a model for data quality targets
limitations: recommendations are not confirmed implementation
maturity varies by force

sources.name: Police National Database quality assessment
verified_claims: PND has provided quarterly force data-quality assessments since 2019
the process runs more than 50 validation and logic checks
checks cover multiple quality dimensions
limitations: PND assessment is distinct from crime-statistics production QA
force engagement is not compulsory

sources.name: PND score construction
verified_claims: PND checks include accuracy validity completeness and uniqueness
checks are weighted and combined
the overall score is out of 100
limitations: the score is not a parcel safety score
weights and process version must be retained

sources.name: PND and Data Hub scope separation
verified_claims: PND focuses largely on person and location data
the process differs from Data Hub reconciliation
direct impact on published crime-count statistics can be limited
limitations: indirect quality improvements are possible
the two processes must not be merged

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Stop-search datetime precision
verified_claims: some forces provide only dates for stop and search
date-only records can appear at midnight
datetime precision varies by force
limitations: midnight concentration may be an artefact
time-of-day analysis requires precision checks

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Stop-search outcome missingness contract
verified_claims: outcome false means nothing was found
an empty outcome means no outcome was provided
outcome-linked-to-object can be null when not provided
limitations: false empty and null are not equivalent
missing states must not be converted to zero
